description: Search Instagram hashtags whose name contains the query string (leading '#' is ignored).

q.description: The hashtag search query; a leading '#' is stripped before matching.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of matching hashtag objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single hashtag by its id.

hashtag_id.description: The unique id of the hashtag.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the hashtag object (id, name, media_count); on failure (hashtag not found), output contains an error message.

description: List a user's recent media whose caption contains the given hashtag, most recent first.

hashtag_id.description: The unique id of the hashtag.

user_id.description: The id of the user whose media is scanned for the hashtag.

limit.description: Maximum number of media items to return (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of media objects; on failure (hashtag not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the child media items of a carousel album media object.

media_id.description: The unique id of the carousel album media.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of child media objects; on failure (media not found or not a carousel album), output contains an error message.

description: List non-hidden comments on a media object, most recent first, with pagination.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of comments to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of comment objects and a 'paging' object; on failure (media not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get lifetime insight metrics for a media object, optionally filtered to specific metrics.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media.

metric.description: Optional comma-separated list of metric names to filter by (e.g. 'impressions,reach').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of metric objects; on failure (media not found, no insights, or invalid metric), output contains an error message.

description: Create a comment (or a reply to a parent comment) on a media object, posted as the primary account.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media to comment on.

parent_id.description: Optional id of a parent comment to reply to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created comment object; on failure (media not found or parent comment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a comment from a media object and decrement the media's comment count.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media the comment belongs to.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'success': true; on failure (media or comment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Hide or unhide a comment on a media object.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media the comment belongs to.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment.

hide.description: Whether to hide (true) or unhide (false) the comment (default true).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'success': true; on failure (media or comment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single media object by its id.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the media object; on failure (media not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a media object by its id.

media_id.description: The unique id of the media to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'success': true; on failure (media not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the replies to a comment, oldest first, with pagination.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the parent comment.

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of replies to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of reply comment objects and a 'paging' object; on failure (comment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single comment by its id.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the comment object; on failure (comment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single story by its id.

story_id.description: The unique id of the story.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the story object; on failure (story not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the publishing status of a media container by its id.

container_id.description: The unique id of the media container.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the container id, status, and status_code; on failure (container not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search users whose username or name contains the query string.

q.description: The user search query matched against username and name.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of matching user objects; on failure (empty query), output contains an error message.

description: List a user's media, most recent first, optionally filtered by media type, with pagination.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

media_type.description: Optional media type filter (e.g. 'IMAGE', 'VIDEO', 'CAROUSEL_ALBUM'); matched case-insensitively.

limit.description: Maximum number of media items to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of media items to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of media objects and a 'paging' object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List a user's active stories, most recent first.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of story objects; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get aggregated account-level insight metrics for a user, optionally filtered to specific metrics.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

metric.description: Optional comma-separated list of metric names to filter by (e.g. 'impressions,reach,follower_count').

period.description: The aggregation period label applied to returned metrics (default 'day').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of metric objects; on failure (user not found or invalid metric), output contains an error message.

description: List mentions of a user, most recent first, with pagination.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

limit.description: Maximum number of mentions to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of mentions to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of mention objects and a 'paging' object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a media container (draft) for a user in preparation for publishing.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user creating the container.

image_url.description: Optional URL of the image to publish.

video_url.description: Optional URL of the video to publish.

media_type.description: The media type of the container (default 'IMAGE'; 'CAROUSEL_ALBUM' requires children).

children.description: Optional list of child container ids, required for a CAROUSEL_ALBUM.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the new container 'id'; on failure (user not found or carousel missing children), output contains an error message.

description: Publish a previously created media container, creating a new media object for the user.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user publishing the container.

creation_id.description: The id of the media container to publish.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the new media 'id'; on failure (user not found, container not found, or container not ready), output contains an error message.

description: Update a user's profile fields (biography, website, name).

user_id.description: The unique id of the user to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated user object; on failure (no fields provided or user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single user (account) by its id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.
